elements.label: Table A3
elements.title: Built-In Functions for Binomial and Poisson Distributions in MS Excel
elements.details:
| Probability Distribution | Excel Command    | Usage                                               |
|--------------------------|------------------|-----------------------------------------------------|
| Binomial                 | =BINOMIAL.DIST   | =BINOMIAL.DIST(Number_s, Trials, Probability_S, Cumulative) |
| Poisson                  | =POISSON         | =POSSON(X, Mean, Cumulative)                         |
elements.summary: This table lists the Excel built-in functions for analyzing binomial and Poisson probability distributions, showing the command names and their usage formats.
